# Brand Catalogue Checklist: Brand catalogue and its upkeep

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of ST-39: data integrity, the loader, the search API contract and the garage-brand rules.
**Created**: 2026-10-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [data-model.md](../data-model.md), [contracts/brands.md](../contracts/brands.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`; depth Standard, audience PR reviewer, focus data integrity, loader, search contract, garage-brand rules. Autonomous run: the reviewer's answers were taken from the spec and plan, and each item below was evaluated against them.
**Review Ownership**: `[x]` means the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied; it does not mean implementation is complete. A struck item (`~~`) does not apply, with its reason.

## Data integrity

- [x] CHK001 Is "a change" defined so that idempotence (no change, no audit entry) can be judged? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004] — created, retired, brought back, or name/slug/popularity changed.
- [x] CHK002 Are uniqueness rules stated for key, name and slug, including against retired stored brands? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK003 Is the identity that survives a rename defined independently of name and slug? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK004 Is the all-or-nothing outcome of a refused file stated measurably ("exactly what it was before")? [Measurability, Spec §FR-007, §SC-002]
- [x] CHK005 Are the audit-event kinds consistent between the story text, FR-008 and the Key Entities (created, renamed, retired, brought back, popularity)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008] — fixed: story scenario 6 and Key Entities now name every kind.
- [x] CHK006 Is the id type of a brand stated? [Gap] — UUID, Spec §FR-002.
- [x] CHK007 Are the limits on brand note and refusal phrase stated at both boundaries, with the blank-text rule? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-016, Edge Cases]

## Loader

- [x] CHK008 Is the activation rule unambiguous (a brand is active exactly when it is in the file)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-006]
- [x] CHK009 Is the reactivation of a retired brand specified as the same row and id? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK010 Is the outcome of a refused file at startup stated (what the API does when the load fails)? [Gap, data-model.md Loader semantics] — fixed: data-model now says a refused file fails the load and the API does not start.
- [x] CHK011 Is the cache-drop requirement tied to a changing run only, and the cache failure behaviour stated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, data-model.md Cache]
- [x] CHK012 Is the trigger for running the loader specified? [Completeness, plan.md Design decision 3]
- [x] CHK013 Is the audit actor for loader changes specified without ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008] — `system`.

## Search API contract

- [x] CHK014 Is "ignores accents and case" defined with objective examples? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK015 Are the response shape, page size and cursor semantics specified, including the invalid-cursor error? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, contracts/brands.md]
- [x] CHK016 Is the ordering stated for both empty and non-empty queries, with ties and unranked brands? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, contracts/brands.md Order, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Is the treatment of a whitespace-only `q` specified? [Gap, contracts/brands.md] — fixed: trimmed, then treated as empty.
- [x] CHK018 Are the input limits of `q` and `cursor` and the error codes for violating them stated? [Completeness, contracts/brands.md Query]
- [x] CHK019 Is the visitor access requirement paired with a checkable acceptance (public-routes list)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK020 Is the cache lifetime and its invalidation observable in a requirement? [Measurability, Spec §US2 scenario 6, §FR-009]

## Garage-brand rules

- [x] CHK021 Are all three answers and the absent-row meaning defined, including for a retired brand? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, §FR-017, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK022 Is every stance transition specified, including the tick reset when a refused brand is worked on again? [Coverage, data-model.md State transitions, Spec §FR-014] — covered in data-model.md; the spec states the default and the clearing rule.
- [x] CHK023 Is the job-row precondition (works_on only) and its refusal code specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, contracts/brands.md]
- [x] CHK024 Is the scope boundary with ST-397 and ST-412 (tables and rules only, no writing screens) explicit? [Clarity, Spec Assumptions]
- [x] ~~CHK025 Are requirements defined for editing fuel ticks of a works_on row?~~ Does not apply: ST-397 builds it (Spec Assumptions).
- [x] CHK026 Is the missing foreign key on `job_type_id` documented as a deliberate, temporary dependency? [Dependency, Spec Clarifications, data-model.md]

## Notes

- Items are checked by the reviewer; `/speckit-implement` reads the state and never changes markers.
